final: WITH per AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS n_scans, AVG(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0 THEN gbsize*1.0/spanmin END) AS avg_rate FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS g FROM per WHERE avg_rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(n_scans*1.0) AS avg_scans, AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(avg_rate - (SELECT g FROM overall)) AS avg_excess FROM per WHERE avg_rate > (SELECT g FROM overall)
